column3: Bills of Exchange (Amendment) Act,

the  principal  enactment 
is  hereby
by the renumbering of that section as subsection
(1) of that section; and
by the addition immediately after the renumbered
subsection  (1)  of  that  section, of  the  following
new subsection: -
“(2) The banker paying the cheque under
subsection (1), shall not incur any liability by
reason only of the absence of, or irregularity
in, indorsement and the payment discharges
the cheque.”.

the  principal  enactment 
is  hereby
repealed and the following section is substituted therefor: -
81. (1) Where a person takes a crossed cheque
which bears on it the words “not negotiable”, he
shall not have and shall not be capable of giving
a  better  title  to  the  cheque  than  that  which  the
person from whom he took it had.
(2) Where a cheque is crossed or uncrossed
and  bears  across  its  face  the  words  “Account
Payee”  or  “A/C  Payee”  either  with  or  without

the  word  “Only”, 
the  cheque 
shall  not  be
transferable, and shall only be valid as between
the parties thereto.”.

is  hereby
